## 5 Featured Production Case Studies
1. **Real-Time Distributed Telemetry Engine**: High-throughput telemetry pipeline aggregating metrics with sub-15ms query response times using PostgreSQL partitioning and Redis memory buffers.
2. **ACID Transactional Payment Engine**: Secure multi-gateway payment processing (Chapa, Telebirr, Stripe) with cryptographic HMAC webhook validation and idempotent ledger state transitions preventing double-charges.
3. **Hybrid Vector RAG Search Platform**: Dual-mode semantic search combining lexical BM25 and pgvector embeddings for grounded, hallucination-free document retrieval.
4. **Enterprise Playwright End-to-End Automated QA Suite**: Automated test suite simulating complex user flows, payment edge cases, and network timeouts across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit on every pull request.
5. **Containerized Zero-Downtime Multi-Stage Cloud Pipeline**: Minimal Docker images with Nginx reverse proxying, GitHub Actions CI/CD, and automatic health probe rollbacks for consistent 99.9% uptime.
